svg.title: Using the ABCDE criteria, which mole characteristics should the nurse report to the provider? Select all that apply.
svg.desc: ABCDE: Asymmetry, Border irregularity, Color variation, Diameter greater than 6 mm, and Evolving — any one warrants evaluation for melanoma, and a lesion that is changing meets the E criterion. A stable, uniformly colored lesion and a small unchanged 3 mm lesion meet none of the criteria.

g.text: STUDY HUB / QUESTION MAP
ABCDE Criteria
Read the situation
Using the ABCDE criteria, which mole
characteristics should the nurse report to
the provider? Select all that apply.
What fits here
One half of the lesion does not match the
other half · Notched, irregular borders ·
Multiple colors within a single lesion · A
lesion that has doubled in size over 3
months
Why it fits
ABCDE: Asymmetry, Border irregularity,
Color variation, Diameter greater than 6
mm, and Evolving — any one warrants
evaluation for melanoma, and a lesion that
is changing meets the E criterion. A
stable, uniformly colored lesion and a
small unchanged 3 mm lesion meet none of
the criteria.
